description: Human visual ground-truth annotations for satellite semantic search evaluation.
labeling_rules: Conservative visual relevance: a tile is marked relevant only if the concept is visibly present at a meaningful level in actual GeoTIFF imagery.

river.notes: tile_1.tif contains a prominent, wide river channel along the left side with a bridge crossing.
river.uncertainty: tile_4.tif contains a narrow canal/waterway; excluded under strict river definition.

water.notes: tile_1.tif features a large open river body; tile_4.tif features a visible dark linear water channel/canal and pond feature along the right edge.
water.uncertainty: None. Surface water is distinctly visible in both tile_1.tif and tile_4.tif.

road.notes: All 4 tiles exhibit clear road and transport infrastructure: tile_1.tif has a major bridge and city street grid; tile_2.tif has arterial corridors; tile_3.tif has distinct avenues and a traffic circle; tile_4.tif has major transit and road convergence.
road.uncertainty: None. Transport corridors and paved road networks are clearly present across all four urban tiles.

buildings.notes: All 4 tiles have high-density built structures, residential/commercial rooftops, and urban building footprints.
buildings.uncertainty: None. Structures are visibly present across all four tiles.

urban area.notes: All 4 tiles encompass developed, high-density urban and metropolitan environments.
urban area.uncertainty: None. Built-up urban fabric covers substantial portions of every tile.

vegetation.notes: tile_2.tif has a north-south linear green corridor and park trees; tile_3.tif has large open green grounds and tree clusters on the left; tile_4.tif has a central green park and vegetated canal banks.
vegetation.uncertainty: tile_1.tif contains minor green field patches in the bottom-left corner, but excluded under conservative threshold as it is dominated by urban fabric and river.

green area.notes: tile_2.tif features a green corridor and park spaces; tile_3.tif features large open grassy/park areas on the left; tile_4.tif features a central green wooded park and green canal corridor.
green area.uncertainty: tile_1.tif has small sports/park squares, but not significant contiguous green area.

urban areas near water.notes: tile_1.tif shows high-density urban buildings immediately adjacent to the large river; tile_4.tif shows urban development bordering the canal/waterway.
urban areas near water.uncertainty: tile_4.tif water feature is smaller than tile_1.tif's river, but clearly adjacent to urban structures.

buildings near a river.notes: tile_1.tif contains dense buildings constructed directly along the major river bank.
buildings near a river.uncertainty: tile_4.tif has buildings along a narrow canal/waterway; excluded under strict river definition.

roads through green areas.notes: tile_3.tif has roads cutting through and bordering the large park grounds on the left; tile_2.tif has road corridors passing along the linear green belt; tile_4.tif has roads adjacent to the central green park.
roads through green areas.uncertainty: Roads in tile_2.tif and tile_4.tif run alongside rather than directly through deep forest; tile_3.tif is the clearest example.

water surrounded by vegetation.notes: tile_4.tif has a canal/water channel closely flanked by green trees and vegetated banks.
water surrounded by vegetation.uncertainty: tile_1.tif's river is mostly lined by concrete/urban embankments rather than dense natural vegetation.

urban area with roads.notes: All 4 tiles feature developed urban areas integrated with transportation grids.

buildings and roads.notes: All 4 tiles contain dense co-occurring building structures and paved road networks.

green area near water.notes: tile_4.tif shows distinct green tree canopy and vegetated banks directly bordering the waterway.
green area near water.uncertainty: tile_1.tif has a small park in the bottom-left near the river, but the riverbank is largely urban.

dense urban area.notes: All 4 tiles depict dense metropolitan built-up areas, with tile_2.tif and tile_3.tif showing especially contiguous building density.
